visual_selection: AI visual selection, followed by larger-image reinspection of selected candidates. Recognizable familiar home furniture and appliances, contemporary/simple style preferred. No human-review or recognition-benchmark claim.

final_review_replacements.reason: Replace tight/cropped framing with complete recognizable objects. Some clear traditional pieces retained; not every asset is strictly modern.

category_policy: Original source categories in the canonical 18-field manifest; reviewed categories in objaverse_200.curation.json. All IDs/previews belong to the reviewed 200-asset selection.
uniqueness: 200 distinct asset IDs and distinct original preview SHA-256 values. Similar models and colour variants can remain; not a geometry-level deduplication claim.
scope: Original preview images and metadata only; no GLB meshes, database, embedding or index changes. Checksum is preview bytes, not GLB.
